name: dolphin_whistles
prompt: A single bottlenose dolphin producing clear tonal whistles with pauses between them, recorded underwater with a hydrophone. Only one dolphin, no other sounds, no music, dry, no reverb.

name: dolphin_clicks
prompt: A single dolphin echolocation click train, fast ticking clicks that speed up into a buzz then stop, underwater hydrophone recording. Only one animal, no other sounds, dry, no reverb.

name: dolphin_whistle_click_mix
prompt: A single dolphin whistling and clicking alternately, playful chatter, underwater hydrophone recording. One dolphin only, no other sounds, no music, dry, no reverb.

name: dolphin_squeaks_young
prompt: A single young dolphin making short high-pitched squeaks and chirps, underwater recording. Only one animal, no other sounds, dry, no reverb.

name: humpback_song
prompt: Humpback whale song from a single whale: long low moans, groans and rising cries in repeating phrases, underwater hydrophone recording. Only one whale, no other sounds, no music, dry, no reverb.

name: whale_calls_sparse
prompt: A single large whale producing a few isolated deep low-frequency calls with long silences between them, underwater recording. No other sounds, no music, dry, no reverb.

name: whale_distant
prompt: A very distant whale moan heard faintly through deep water, muffled and low, mostly quiet water silence in between. Single whale, no other sounds, no music.

name: bubbles_rising
prompt: Gentle air bubbles rising and popping underwater, close hydrophone recording. Only bubbles, no voices, no music, no other sounds, dry.

name: swimmer_strokes
prompt: A single diver slowly swimming past underwater, soft water displacement from fin kicks, occasional regulator bubbles. Only this, no music, no other sounds, dry.

name: ocean_bed
prompt: Quiet deep ocean underwater ambience, soft low hydrophone water rumble and faint distant hiss. Only water, no animals, no bubbles, no music, no melody, steady.

name: deep_drone_low
prompt: A very low sub-bass drone, slowly evolving, steady hum with no rhythm and no melody. Single sustained tone only, no music, no voices, no other sounds.

name: deep_drone_hollow
prompt: A hollow dark low-pitched resonant drone like air in a huge empty metal chamber, very slow movement, no rhythm, no melody, no music, no other sounds.

name: cosmic_swell
prompt: A slow, wide, soft swell of filtered noise rising and falling like a tide, one gentle wave every ten seconds. Only this, no melody, no music, no impacts, no other sounds.

name: comet_pass
prompt: A single fast whoosh of a large object passing by, smooth rising then falling airy rush with a soft low tail. One pass only, no impact, no music, no explosion, no other sounds, dry.

name: pulsar_pulses
prompt: Distant regular soft low pulses, one dull thump about every two seconds, steady and faint like a slow far-away heartbeat of a machine. Only the pulse, no melody, no music, no other sounds.

name: shimmer_high
prompt: A quiet high shimmering texture of fine glassy airy noise, sparkling and slowly changing, no pitch, no melody, no rhythm, no music, no other sounds.
